title: Page 6
content_zh:
流水潺潺，秋日午后的戚家花园里，两名年轻男子正对坐在凉亭里悠闲品茗，气氛轻松又惬意。
其中一名男子身穿天蓝色衣袍，袍面以银线绣上精致的竹叶花纹，一看就知道不是寻常人能够穿得起的，而他面貌儒雅俊逸，还带有一股超脱尘世的淡然气质，让人有种错觉，好像看到天上谪仙人一样，对他没来由的崇拜景仰不已。
他正是戚家的二公子，戚无烟。
而坐在他对面的另一名男子叫梁昭旭，他脸色苍白，一副病容，就算他长得不比戚无烟差，脸上始终保持着淡淡的笑容，给人的印象还是比戚无烟逊了好大一截。
“无烟，你觉得我家妹子如何？”
“你怎么会突然问我这个？”戚无烟纳闷地微微挑眉。
“你先回答我，我再回答你。”他还是笑，非常耐心地等着戚无烟给答案。
看着好友那隐隐期待的眼神，戚无烟有些尴尬，老实回答：“……说实话，不太记得。”
“记不得？”梁昭旭不得不摇头失笑。“无烟，我还真是服了你，昭颖虽然是文静了点，但她跟着我来戚家也不少次，连你的大哥、三弟、四弟都早已认得她，你居然说记不得？”
经他这么一说，戚无烟才似乎有那么一点点记忆，昭旭身旁似乎有时候会跟着一个非常文静的小姑娘，几乎不说话、不吵闹，就只是静静的坐在一旁听他们谈话。
但她到底长什么样……嗯，他还真的是想不起来。
“你也知道我的个性，我懒得记太多事情。”戚无烟耸耸肩，并不是很在意这一件事。
“你不是懒，你是不在乎，所以才对身旁和自己没什么关系的人、事、物都不经心。”梁昭旭很清楚，好友的个性淡漠，像是个对任何事情都无欲无求的谪仙人，很少在意些什么事情。
但更正确的说法，应该说他对没兴趣的事情便无欲无求，连理都懒得理，但如果是他有兴趣的事，或是和自己切身相关的事情，那可就不一定了。
“随便，反正我无所谓。”戚无烟依旧漫不在乎地耸肩，悠闲喝茶。“我说完了，所以该换你了吧？”
“是呀，该换我了。”梁昭旭轻啜口茶，有些感慨地说：“无烟，如果哪一天我不在了，我希望你能代替我照顾昭颖，别让她过得太孤单。”
“你现在是在向我‘托孤’？好端端的说这种话干什么，你们家不是还有伯母在，又不是没人了。”戚无烟眉一皱，没好气地瞪向好友，很不喜欢听他这么说。
梁昭旭忧虑地说：“我娘不太喜欢昭颖，我跟你说过，你该不会也记不得了吧？”
“……”戚无烟尴尬地无言以对，的确是忘了。
梁昭旭和妹妹梁昭颖其实是龙凤胎，生下来后，梁昭旭一直体弱多病，而梁昭颖却非常健康的成长，兄妹的身体状况是天差地远。

梁母一刚开始只是有些不舒服，觉得是昭颖在她的肚子里时把该给昭旭的健康给一并拿走，才会害得他天生病骨，所以从小对昭颖就比较冷淡一点。
几年之后，梁父突患急病而亡，梁母忍着伤痛一肩担起家业，对唯一可以传承香火的昭旭更是保护在意，而对昭颖则变本加厉地不满，在不知不觉间把丧夫之痛及对独子的忧虑转而发泄在昭颖身上，对她多有怨怼。
这一切梁昭旭都看在眼里，他知道妹妹是无辜的，而她向来只是静静地承受母亲的怨怼，所以他很担心，如果他真的早一步离开，妹妹就会失去唯一疼她的人，而母亲对她的埋怨恐怕会更深重。
“昭旭，你只是身体弱一些而已，别想太多。”戚无烟的双眉依旧紧蹙，很不喜欢他对自己的身体状况如此悲观。
“我不得不想多一点，毕竟……世事难料……”梁昭旭倒是早已看开一切，语气淡然。
而就在这一年冬天，梁昭旭感染风寒，就这样一病不起，走的时候才十八岁，而戚无烟二十三。
戚无烟很震惊，几乎无法接受好友年纪轻轻便离开人世的事实，直到来到灵堂前向好友上香，他才真正面对这件事，对好友的早逝感到无比惋惜。
回想起两人两年前的初次相见，他在路上和梁昭旭擦肩而过，不小心碰掉梁昭旭怀中刚从画坊拿回来已裱好的自娱书画，他捡拾起时不经意瞧见里头的图画，顿时惊为天人，非常喜欢。
看到梁昭旭的图，他突然有个念头，希望梁昭旭能画些适合刺绣的图稿，让绣娘可以绣在无戚布庄出产的布料上，以此做为布庄的特色之一，两人因为合作关系往来频繁而成为好友。
他脑海中的过往回忆依旧印象鲜明，好像才刚在不久前发生而已，没想到好友的生命却已经走到尽头，令人不胜唏嘘。
而梁昭旭最放心不下的妹妹梁昭颖，静静地跪在堂前帮哥哥烧纸钱，直到这一刻，戚无烟才第一次正视她的存在，想到好友将妹妹托付给他的事情。
她一身白衣，素着一张苍白的脸，眼眶微红，看起来非常憔悴，如果除去憔悴的脸色不谈，其实她是个文静典雅的水灵小姑娘，非常的惹人怜爱。
原本平静的心湖蓦地震荡开一波涟漪，对于她的处境他感到心疼又怜惜，再也无法对她视而不见。
“昭颖。”
小姑娘终于抬起头，用着微泛水光的眼神望着他，更显得楚楚可怜。
“以后如果有什么困难，可以来戚家找我，你可以把我当成另一个哥哥，不必客气，知道吗？”虽然他讨厌招惹麻烦，但她不一样，她是好友生前托付给他的最后一个牵挂，他无法置之不理。
况且，她的柔弱无助勾起他怜惜之情，发自内心地想好好照顾她，不希望她受委屈的时候没有人可以让她依靠。
但梁昭颖并没有马上给他任何响应，只是低下头，继续默默地帮哥哥烧纸钱，像是不怎么习惯接受他的好意。
面对她的疏离淡漠，戚无烟倒也不怎么在意，他想她也需要时间调适心情，才能够从伤痛中走出来。
所以他可以等，等她愿意面对他的时候……

冬雪缓缓地落下，不知不觉间，一个月的时间已经过去，这段时间戚无烟都要人固定将梁家的消息告诉他，关心梁家的近况，如果她们母女有什么困难，他非常愿意提供帮助。
就在两个月之后，梁昭颖终于主动上戚家找戚无烟了，当他来到前厅，以为她是有什么困难或委屈要找他时，眼前的她却让他整个人错愕惊愣，简直是……不敢相信。
她……她竟然剪去及腰的长发到肩，只剩下一般男子的发长，学男子习惯的束发，而且还穿着……男人的衣袍，活脱脱像是一个尚未成年的俊秀小少年！
发生什么事了？是天要塌下来了吗？梁昭颖一看到戚无烟出现，居然一改之前那文静到几乎没声音的性子，主动且爽朗地和他打招呼一一“无烟哥，好久不见了！”
“昭颖，你……你……”他忍不住错愕，原本的文静小丫头呢？她真的是昭颖吗？“我很好，请无烟哥不必担心啦。”
才怪！她一点都不像很好的模样，她……难道是受了什么刺激，所以才突然之间“性情大变”？梁昭颖朗笑出声，猜得出他在想什么。“无烟哥，我真的很好，我只是彻底想通一些事情而已。”
content_en:
The water is gurgling, and in the Qi family garden on an autumn afternoon, two young men are sitting opposite each other in the pavilion, enjoying a leisurely cup of tea. The atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable.
One of the men was wearing a sky-blue robe with delicate bamboo leaf patterns embroidered with silver thread. One look at it showed that it was not something that ordinary people could afford. His face was elegant and handsome, and he also had an otherworldly and indifferent temperament, which made people have the illusion that they were seeing an immortal banished from the sky, and they worshiped him for no reason.
He is the second son of the Qi family, Qi Wuyan.
The other man sitting opposite him was named Liang Zhaoxu. He was pale and sickly. Even though he looked no worse than Qi Wuyan, he always kept a faint smile on his face, which gave people a much inferior impression than Qi Wuyan.
"Wu Yan, what do you think of my girl?"
"Why did you suddenly ask me this?" Qi Wuyan raised his eyebrows slightly in confusion.
"Answer me first, and then I'll answer you." He still smiled and waited patiently for Qi Wuyan's answer.
Seeing the vague expectant look in his friend's eyes, Qi Wuyan felt a little embarrassed and answered honestly: "...To be honest, I don't really remember."
"Can't remember?" Liang Zhaoxu had to shake his head and laugh. "Wuyan, I really admire you. Although Zhaoying is a little quieter, she has followed me to Qi's house many times. Even your eldest brother, third brother, and fourth brother have recognized her for a long time. You actually said you can't remember her?"
After what he said, Qi Wuyan seemed to have a little memory. Zhaoxu seemed to be accompanied by a very quiet little girl sometimes. She hardly spoke or made any noise, and just sat quietly and listened to their conversation.
But what she looked like...well, he really couldn't remember.
"You also know my personality. I'm too lazy to remember too many things." Qi Wuyan shrugged, not really caring about this matter.
"You're not lazy, you just don't care. That's why you don't pay attention to people, things and things around you that have nothing to do with you." Liang Zhaoxu knew very well that his friend had an indifferent personality, like an immortal who had no desire for anything and rarely cared about anything.
But a more correct statement should be that he has no desire or desire for things that he is not interested in, and he is too lazy to deal with them. But if it is something that he is interested in, or something that is closely related to him, that is not necessarily the case.
"Whatever, it doesn't matter to me anyway." Qi Wuyan still shrugged nonchalantly and drank tea leisurely. "I'm done, so it's your turn, right?"
"Yes, it's my turn." Liang Zhaoxu took a sip of tea and said with some emotion: "Wuyan, if one day I am no longer here, I hope you can take care of Zhaoying on my behalf and not let her live too lonely."
"Are you asking me to leave you alone now? Why are you saying such things so politely? Your aunt is still here, and it's not like there is no one left at home." Qi Wuyan frowned and glared at his friend angrily, not liking what he said.
Liang Zhaoxu said worriedly: "My mother doesn't like Zhaoying very much. I told you, but you can't remember it, right?"
"..." Qi Wuyan was embarrassed and speechless. He had indeed forgotten.
Liang Zhaoxu and his sister Liang Zhaoying are actually twins. After birth, Liang Zhaoxu has been frail and sickly, but Liang Zhaoying has grown up very healthily. The physical conditions of the brother and sister are very different.
Mother Liang was only a little uncomfortable at first, feeling that Zhaoying had taken away the health that should be given to Zhaoxu when she was in her belly, which caused him to be born sick and bones, so she had been colder towards Zhaoying since she was a child.
A few years later, Liang's father suddenly died of a sudden illness. Liang's mother endured the pain and shouldered the family business. She was even more protective of Zhaoxu, the only one who could pass on the incense. However, she became even more dissatisfied with Zhaoying. Unknowingly, she vented her pain of losing her husband and worries about her only son on Zhaoying, and she was resentful towards her.
Liang Zhaoxu saw all this. He knew that his sister was innocent, but she had always just endured it quietly.His mother was resentful, so he was worried that if he really left early, his sister would lose the only person who loved her, and his mother's complaints against her would probably be even deeper.
"Zhaoxu, you're just weak, don't think too much." Qi Wuyan's eyebrows were still frowning, and she didn't like that he was so pessimistic about his physical condition.
"I have to think more, after all... things are unpredictable..." Liang Zhaoxu had already looked away from everything, and his tone was indifferent.
And in the winter of that year, Liang Zhaoxu contracted a cold and couldn't afford to fall ill. He was only eighteen years old when he left, while Qi Wuyan was twenty-three.
Qi Wuyan was shocked and could hardly accept the fact that his friend passed away at a young age. It was not until he came to the mourning hall to offer incense to his friend that he truly faced the matter and felt extremely sorry for his friend's early death.
Recalling the first time the two met two years ago, he passed by Liang Zhaoxu on the road and accidentally knocked out the framed self-entertainment calligraphy and painting that Liang Zhaoxu had just brought back from the art workshop. When he picked it up, he accidentally saw the pictures inside and was immediately shocked and liked it very much.
Seeing Liang Zhaoxu's drawings, he suddenly had the idea that Liang Zhaoxu could draw some drawings suitable for embroidery so that the embroiderer could embroider them on the fabrics produced by Wuqi Cloth Factory. This would become one of the characteristics of the cloth shop. The two became good friends because of their frequent exchanges of cooperation.
The past memories were still vivid in his mind, as if they had happened not long ago. Unexpectedly, his friend's life had come to an end, which was very sad.
As for Liang Zhaoxu's most uneasy sister, Liang Zhaoying, she knelt quietly in front of the hall to help her brother burn paper money. It was only at this moment that Qi Wuyan faced her existence for the first time and thought about the fact that his friend had entrusted his sister to him.
She was dressed in white, had a pale face, and her eyes were reddish. She looked very haggard. Aside from her haggard look, she was actually a quiet and elegant young girl who was very lovable.
A wave of ripples suddenly shook his originally calm heart. He felt distressed and pitiful for her situation, and could no longer turn a blind eye to her.
"Zhaoying."
The little girl finally raised her head and looked at him with slightly watery eyes, looking even more pitiful.
"If you have any difficulties in the future, you can come to Qi's house to find me. You can treat me as another brother. You don't have to be polite, you know?" Although he hates causing trouble, she is different. She is the last concern that his friend entrusted to him during his lifetime, and he cannot ignore it.
Moreover, her weakness and helplessness aroused his pity, and he wanted to take good care of her from the bottom of his heart. He didn't want anyone to rely on her when she was wronged.
But Liang Zhaoying did not give him any response immediately. She just lowered her head and continued to silently help her brother burn paper money, as if she was not used to accepting his kindness.
Faced with her alienation and indifference, Qi Wuyan didn't care much. He thought she needed time to adjust her mood before she could get over the pain.
So he can wait until she is willing to face him...
The winter snow fell slowly, and before you knew it, a month had passed. During this period, Qi Wuyan asked people to regularly tell him the news about the Liang family. He was concerned about the current situation of the Liang family. If the mother and daughter had any difficulties, he was very willing to help.
Just two months later, Liang Zhaoying finally took the initiative to go to Qi's house to find Qi Wuyan. When he came to the front hall, thinking that she was looking for him if she had any difficulties or grievances, the sight of her in front of him made him stunned. He simply... couldn't believe it.
She...she actually cut off her waist-length hair to her shoulders, leaving only the hair of an ordinary man. She tied her hair in the way men are accustomed to it, and she also wore...a man's robe, looking exactly like a handsome young boy who has not yet reached adulthood!
What happened? Is the sky going to fall? As soon as Liang Zhaoying saw Qi Wuyan appear, she changed her previous quiet and almost silent temperament and became proactive and cheerful.Greeting him one by one - "Brother Wuyan, long time no see!"
"Zhao Ying, you... you..." He couldn't help but be surprised, where was the original quiet little girl? Is she really Zhaoying? "I'm fine. Brother Wuyan, please don't worry."
That’s weird! She doesn't look good at all. She...could she have been stimulated by something, so she suddenly had a "big change in temperament"? Liang Zhaoying laughed loudly, guessing what he was thinking. "Brother Wuyan, I'm really fine. I just thought about some things thoroughly."
